final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT si.healtheval, SUM(s.scancount) AS scans_sum, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS avg_size_per_min FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY si.healtheval), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_size_per_min) AS overall_avg FROM step1) SELECT step1.healtheval, step1.scans_sum, step1.avg_size_per_min, step1.avg_size_per_min - step2.overall_avg FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
